wiki.title: Stone Heart
wiki.text:
Stone Heart is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Festival of Hearts. He is a heart-shaped monster, his main goal while arrived is to destroy the Love Potions in Merry Vale which will break all the people's love.

Biography
Before the Festival of Hearts, Rylan and Arianna who were two lovers met long ago and came together near a flower that grew every time they were near each other. One day, dark magic fell over the land and Rylan never showed up again. He went out on the day of dark magic, he got turned into Stone Heart. He gathered the changelings around him. Stone Heart has no love and sees the festival as an insult. He will try to crush as much of the special magic as he can so others will be as lonely as he is.

Battle
Open World
During the time that Stone Heart is arrived, bring sadness and the feeling of heart break to all the people in love. He will slowly walk along the pathways of Merry Vale giving players time to confront the boss, the Love Potions appear on the pathways of Merry Vale. The Love Potions temporarily grant players an enchanted bow with the ability to attack Stone Heart and stop the Heart Breakers from stealing Valentine Love.

Once defeated, Stone Heart drops a special treasure chest that rewards the players that assisted in that specific battle a Festival of Hearts themed item. If he wins, he will successfully destroy the Love Potion that will break all the people's love and disappear which him and the Heart Breakers ruin the Festival of Hearts in Merry Vale, which will not drop anything.
